depiction.primary_object: square note or sticker with smiley face and folded corner
depiction.composition: single object, front view, with corner badge

readings.meaning: new sticky note or happy memo

ambiguity: Could be read as either a chat sticker/emoji pack icon or a physical sticky note/decal; at very small sizes the folded corner and smiley blend into a generic face icon.
task_intents: buy stickers for kids or crafts
log daily mood or gratitude note
leave positive review or kudos note

reasoning: The icon clearly depicts the universal UI symbol for adding a sticker or reaction (a tilted smiling face on a square sheet with a peeled corner and a plus badge). While originating as a messaging button, it maps cleanly onto concrete tasks around digital stickers/emojis, physical stickers/decals, and upbeat sticky notes.
